name: Demo · Psoriasis · ZLV-301 (Phase III)
description: Oral tablets, adults with psoriasis. SAEs within 2 business days; elective pre-planned hospitalizations are not SAEs; visit windows ±3 days to Week 12.

study_rules: Randomization of an ineligible subject is an important protocol deviation. [ELIGIBILITY, critical if broken] (protocol ZLV-301 Amendment 2, p. 2)

Any temperature excursion must be reported to the sponsor within 1 business day, and affected kits must be quarantined and not dispensed until the sponsor approves their use. [TEMP_EXCURSION, critical if broken] (protocol ZLV-301 Amendment 2, p. 3)
Study drug must be interrupted if ALT or AST rises above 3 times the upper limit of normal. [DOSING_ERROR, critical if broken] (protocol ZLV-301 Amendment 2, p. 3)
Returned tablets must be counted at every dispensing visit. [DOSING_ERROR, major if broken] (protocol ZLV-301 Amendment 2, p. 3)

Visits from Week 2 to Week 12 must occur within plus or minus 3 days of the scheduled day; visits from Week 16 onward within plus or minus 7 days. [PROTOCOL_DEVIATION, minor if broken] (protocol ZLV-301 Amendment 2, p. 4)
A missed Week 12 PASI assessment is an important protocol deviation. [PROTOCOL_DEVIATION, major if broken] (protocol ZLV-301 Amendment 2, p. 4)
Worsening of psoriasis is recorded as an adverse event only if it is more severe than the subject's usual fluctuation. [AE_REPORTING] (protocol ZLV-301 Amendment 2, p. 5)
A hospitalization for an elective procedure that was planned before the subject signed the informed consent form is not a serious adverse event. [SAE_REPORTING] (protocol ZLV-301 Amendment 2, p. 5)
All serious adverse events must be reported to the sponsor within 2 business days of the site becoming aware of the event. [SAE_REPORTING, critical if broken] (protocol ZLV-301 Amendment 2, p. 5)
Any pregnancy in a subject must be reported to the sponsor within 24 hours of the site becoming aware of it. [SAFETY_REPORTS, critical if broken] (protocol ZLV-301 Amendment 2, p. 5)

deadlines.what: All serious adverse events must be reported to the sponsor within 2 business days of the site becoming aware of the event.
